# 2 Chronicles 31 — Disagreement Log

## V.1
- **EMET:** "And-as-finished all this went-out all Israel the-found to-cities-of Judah and-they-broke the-pillars and-they-cut-down the-Asherim and-they-tore-down "
- **LOGOS:** "Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces and cut down the Asherim a"
- **PNEUMA:** "When the festival was over, all the Israelites who had attended went out to the towns of Judah and smashed the sacred stones, cut down the Asherah pol"
